Explore the datasets collected and/or used by the lab. Click a point on the map to see what was collected there, or open a project or data type below to filter the data and get the code to retrieve it. Interested in this data but not a member of the lab? Get in touch with us!

```{ojs}
md`**${data.length.toLocaleString()}** datapoints · **${projects.length}** projects · **${datatypes.length}** data types`
```

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="22%"}
```{ojs}
viewof mapFilters = Inputs.form({
  datatype: Inputs.checkbox(dtIds, {label: "Data type", format: dtName}),
  projects: projects.length <= 8
    ? Inputs.checkbox(projects.map(p => p.id), {label: "Project", format: id => projectName.get(id) ?? id})
    : Inputs.select(projects.map(p => p.id), {label: "Project", multiple: true, format: id => projectName.get(id) ?? id})
})
```
:::

::: {.column width="75%"}
```{ojs}
mapView = P.createMap({height: 520})
```

```{ojs}
P.drawMarkers(mapView, mapRows, [], d => {
  const projs = d.projects
    .map(id => `<a href="projects/${id}.html">${P.escapeHtml(projectName.get(id) ?? id)}</a>`)
    .join(", ");
  return `${P.escapeHtml(d.datapoint_name)} · ` +
    `<a href="datatypes/${d.datatype}.html">${P.escapeHtml(dtName(d.datatype))}</a> · ` +
    `${P.escapeHtml(d.date)}${projs ? ` · ${projs}` : ""}`;
})
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {makePortal} from "./assets/portal.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

leaflet = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
P = makePortal({d3, Inputs, html, DOM, leaflet})

// ---- Data written by build.R -----------------------------------------------------
raw      = FileAttachment("_generated/datapoints.csv").csv()
links    = FileAttachment("_generated/project_links.csv").csv()
overview = FileAttachment("_generated/projects_overview.csv").csv()

projects      = P.parseProjects(overview)
projectName   = new Map(projects.map(p => [p.id, p.name]))
projectsByUid = d3.rollup(links, v => v.map(l => l.project_id), l => l.uid)

dtIds     = P.unique(raw, "datatype")
dtMeta    = P.loadDatatypeMeta(dtIds)
dtName    = id => dtMeta.get(id)?.name ?? id
datatypes = P.datatypeSummary(raw, dtMeta)

// ---- Rows on the map -------------------------------------------------------------
data = P.prepareRows(raw, [], {merge: r => ({projects: projectsByUid.get(r.uid) ?? []})})

mapRows = data.filter(d =>
  (!mapFilters.datatype.length || mapFilters.datatype.includes(d.datatype)) &&
  (!mapFilters.projects.length || mapFilters.projects.some(p => d.projects.includes(p))))
```
